login.title: Log in or sign up
login.lead: Log in with an emailed code, or your password if you've set one.
login.humanCheck: Quick check that you're a person:
login.codeLead: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
login.differentEmail: Use a different email or get a new code
login.signupLead: Your username is public. Your email is never shown to anyone.
login.usernameHint: 3–20 letters, numbers or _ , starting with a letter.
login.methodLabel: How do you want to log in?
login.forgotPassword: Forgot your password? Get a code instead
login.newPasswordHint: At least 10 characters. Skip it and you can always log in with a code.
login.googleFailed: Google sign-in didn't work. Please try again, or use an emailed code.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.deleteBody: This permanently deletes your account, your profile and everything linked to it, and logs you out on every device. It can't be undone.
profile.passwordNone: You log in with emailed codes. Add a password if you'd like another way in.
profile.passwordSet: You can log in with your password or an emailed code.
profile.newPasswordHint: At least 10 characters. Changing it logs you out on your other devices.

loginPanel.quote: Every love story deserves a proper letter.

write.title: Write a love note
write.lead: Fill it in, watch it come together, then seal it.
write.titleHint: e.g. my love, babe, sunshine. Used as "Dear …".
write.pickQuote: Pick a quote to start from
write.scheduleLabel: Keep it sealed until (optional, Lagos time)
write.scheduleHint: Leave empty to open straight away. Great for 00:00 on 14 February.
write.sealNeedsAccount: You'll log in or create a free account at this step. Your letter is kept while you do.
write.sealedLead: Your letter is ready. Only people with this link can open it.
write.whatsappText: I wrote you something 💌 Open it here:
write.trackIt: You'll see when it's opened and their reply on your profile.
